title: Temperature types
hints: A `Celsius` supports arithmetic directly (`c*9/5 + 32`), but the result is still a `Celsius`: convert it to the return type with `Fahrenheit(...)`.
For `String`, use `fmt.Sprintf("%.1f°C", float64(c))`. Converting to `float64` matters: formatting `c` itself with `%v` would call `String` again forever.
